themes: Spending before it is too late
summary_for_children: Al-Munafiqun means The Hypocrites. It warns against saying one thing and meaning another, and tells us to spend from what we have before it is too late.
environment_concept: A harvest world where provision is shared before the season ends.
architecture_and_scenery: Orchards, baskets, a timeline of seasons.

activities.name: Share now
activities.description: Share provisions before the season ends (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
